usedFor: Support teams use Botse Ticketing to open requests with “Cricket Support Ticket” when “New Event Is Created” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Cricket Support Ticket” in Botse Ticketing
bestTemplate.why: Each new meeting opens a support request, so the meeting leaves a ticket behind.

watchOut: “New Event Is Created” in Botse Ticketing is polling, so tickets follow a scheduled check with a short delay.
